title: Incentive rebates.
officialText:
With respect to the rebates under section 28-112.6, the commissioner may, at his or her discretion, issue a rebate of application fees as follows and as established by rule.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
